verbatim_quote.original: Access-controlled, audit-logged; deleted messages clearly badged, never hard-deleted.
verbatim_quote.english_translation: Access-controlled, audit-logged; deleted messages clearly badged, never hard-deleted.

extracted_decision.summary: Admin chat viewer must be access-controlled and audit-logged; deleted-flag messages are clearly badged, never hard-deleted; build on the export workflow for reuse, not one-off scripts; respect edge JWT, Origin check and server-only master key.
extracted_decision.rationale: Admin PII surface requires least-privilege access plus audit trail.
extracted_decision.tradeoffs: Auditability and PII protection over convenience.
